instructions: Always follow docs/UI_GUIDELINES.md (v3.0) for all code generation
Every component must have 3 separate files: .ts, .html, .scss — never inline
Models folder must be flat — no sub-folders (state, request, response, mapper, enum files)
Services must call mapper functions — no inline mapping logic
Page components own the topbar — presentational components never render their own
After rewriting a feature, delete old monolithic files and update routes
Verify build with: npm run build -- --configuration=development
